About this experience

The Park features two straight-line systems. System A (60 meters) is designed for complete beginners, offering wakeboarding lessons led by our experienced instructors. The system runs one rider at a time, providing a safe, focused learning environment with full instructor attention. Its gradual cable speed makes learning the basics easier, making it ideal for young children. The Park runs 9 lessons daily, each lasting 1 hour, with a maximum of 4 riders per lesson. Rate: $55 per rider/hour or 1 hour off Share-The-Fun Pass Includes: Helmet, Vest & House Wakeboard (Non-Obstacle) Obstacle Wakeboard Rental: $20/Session - Rate is inclusive of GST & applicable daily - Recommended age for a participating child is 6 years old & above - All riders are required to know basic swimming

What to expect

Your group will be briefed on the scenario — typically a 60-minute escape challenge designed for 6–12 people simultaneously. Unlike solo escape rooms, this one is built for collaboration: clues are distributed across the team from the start.

After the room, a trained facilitator runs a 30-minute structured debrief. It's not a post-mortem — it's a genuine conversation about communication styles, decision-making under pressure, and what your team learned about itself.

No escape room experience needed. First-timers often have the most interesting debrief moments.
